project_type: Python web application - PV solar panel simulation system with HTTP API backend and static HTML/JS frontend
build_system: No build system - raw Python with unittest test framework
test_framework: unittest with discover pattern: python3 -m unittest discover -s backend/tests -p 'test_*.py'
verification_instructions: Run all tests: cd /projects/sandbox/Symulator-PV && python3 -m unittest discover -s backend/tests -p 'test_*.py'. Currently 323 tests passing.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - pure Python project with stdlib + backend/data files.
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.9 available. No Docker needed.
contribution_requirements: All code in Polish naming convention. Docstrings in Polish. Tests follow unittest pattern.
key_patterns: Services in backend/services/. Models in backend/models/. Data in backend/data/ (JSON). Tests in backend/tests/test_*.py. API handlers in backend/api/handlers.py. Frontend is static HTML in frontend/pages/ with JS inline. Panel database is JSON array in panels_database.json. Inverter database in inverters_database.json. Constants like STRATY_SYSTEMOWE_DOMYSLNE=0.03 in panel_performance.py. Bypass threshold at >0.5 in shading.py line 477 and optimizer.py line 126.
directory_structure: backend/ - Python API server (services/, models/, api/, data/, tests/). frontend/ - static HTML/CSS/JS. backend/services/ - main business logic. backend/data/ - JSON databases for panels, inverters, tariffs, RCE cache.
